text: Program Description Economy and Finance major aims to develop basic grasp of economics and finance theory and practice, be familiar with Chinese and international financial regulations and related policies, have a high political quality, good professional ethics, energy systems, and there is a strong level of foreign language and computer application ability, to engage in wide financial technology adaptation and risk management in all types of domestic and foreign banks, securities companies, fund organizations, insurance companies, other financial intermediaries and corporations. Note : If applicant don't have a HSK4 certificate,he/she must have a Chinese preparatory course first.
